01 / GET TO KNOW THE LEARNER

A starting point, not a fixed label.

Onboarding establishes a provisional baseline. Daily learning evidence helps the planner refine what the student needs over time.

02 / PLAN THE NEXT STEP

What, when and how much.

The Individual Learning Planner maintains the learning profile and coordinates topics, study time and pace. Specialist modules deliver the teaching.

03 / RESPOND DURING LEARNING

Context informs the response.

RTAE considers available signals with answers and student feedback. The planner approves changes to an explanation, activity or break.

04 / CHECK WHAT STAYS

Practice. Explain. Revisit.

Practice, doubts, exams and revision feed back into the plan. In Teach Me Something, the learner teaches the AI and its questions help expose gaps.

BEFORE YOU COMMIT

Ask the questions
that matter.

Is the product available immediately?+

No. This is a pre-launch offer, with launch planned for December 2026–January 2027. Phase 1 capacity is 5,000 students. Exact activation dates and launch features will be confirmed before payment opens.

What will a demo help me understand?+

Ask to see how the learning plan is created, how lessons and practice connect, how revision identifies gaps and which features will be available at launch. A demo request does not reserve a student place.

Does a laptop camera measure all 47 parameters?+

No. Available signals depend on consent, supported devices and validated integrations. Camera observations, estimates and device measurements are different sources. RTAE does not read thoughts or establish medical diagnoses; complete signal coverage and learning effectiveness require validation.

Is the PRIA dock included in the founding price?+

The displayed subscription offer does not specify hardware inclusion. Dock availability, compatibility and any separate pricing must be confirmed before checkout.

What are the founding benefits?+

The ₹100 reservation offer includes an introductory month on activation, six paid months at ₹1,399 instead of ₹1,499, and ₹100 credit on the first paid bill. That first paid bill becomes ₹1,299. Thereafter the planned price is ₹1,499/month. Read the full offer details.
